summary: Checks that the three self-hosted fonts are wired into the layout, the design tokens and the shipped font files, and that no font is loaded from an outside website.
purpose: Stops the app from quietly loading fonts from Google or Adobe, which would break the privacy and security rules.
why: Likely reason: fonts are easy to break by accident, and loading them from outside sites would send visitor data to third parties.
how: 1) Reads the layout, token stylesheet and security header file as plain text. 2) Scans the src and public folders for known font host names. 3) Checks that each font package folder contains woff2 font files.
inputs: Files under src and public, src/app/layout.tsx, src/ui/tokens.css, src/providers/securityHeaders.ts, and the installed font packages in node_modules.
outputs: Pass or fail for four checks, with the name of any file that breaks a rule.
risks: The checks match text, not real rendering, so a correct change that uses different wording can fail, and a font file that is present but unused will still pass.
debug: If a check fails, open the file named in the failure and search it for the font package name or the host name. If the file-presence check fails, run the package install again so node_modules is complete.
